summary: Round 41 plan check (light: local reads only, 0 Kaggle API calls; 14:14-14:25Z). The evening chain is armed and its timings hold. Poller cadence is 602 s, so T7 fires ~19:20:28Z, manual-admit runs after the ~19:40:32Z header, and the feed loop is stopped after its ~17:29:20Z run. mk_card_1837.py is sha8 59c54168 with --dry-all 50/50 ok. Three actionable gaps remain. (1) PC41-01: the pre_exp89t.sh job (Windows pid 36816) is still alive even though CONTEXT 13:34Z logs it as CANCELLED. At 17:40Z it will download the LB once or twice inside the 0-call quiet window and change the card builder's default LB source. Kill it before 17:40Z and log it. (2) PC41-02: the pre-registered T7 text and the manual-admit mapping still say '≥ 0.960 или 0.959 с UP' / T3 / T4_question, which contradicts decision B. R40-A4 replaced only T3/UPWAIT/T4. Log the corrected T7 text and mapping (exact Russian text given). (3) PC41-03: mk_card_1837.py never checks CODE against --disp/--hdr/--lhi. A slip at 18:37Z (T1 at 0.959, T2 past the 19:45:17Z edge, T3KEEP after the edge, or the obsolete T3) builds a card that breaks decision B, and the token checks pass. A tested guard patch rejects all these cases (35/35 valid variants still ok); it also changes the --lb default away from the cancelled pre_exp89t. Minor items: PC41-04 (the LB line label is 14:45 МСК from the file mtime, but the snapshot is 11:41Z; the rank #141 is older than Chrome's #148; an empty post_exp89t folder crashes the builder), PC41-05 (lastok skips valid retry blocks; ~0.5%/poll, harmless), PC41-06 (liveness), PC41-07 (00:07Z commit: no trailer, add the S0 folder). No rule rewrite, no build, no slot-2 file.

findings.what: The 17:40Z pre_exp89t save job is still running, although CONTEXT 13:34Z (decision B) says it was CANCELLED. Windows pid 36816 (bash scratchpad/pre_exp89t.sh, started 10:53Z) is alive at 14:15Z. At 17:40Z it will run 'uptest.py save pre_exp89t', one full LB download plus one retry at ~17:45Z on failure. Those calls fall inside the 17:30-20:00Z window where agents make 0 Kaggle calls (R39-A6, the 15:57Z ban-report load cut), and the save has no decision value under B. It would also create _lb/pre_exp89t, which is the default --lb of mk_card_1837.py, so the card's LB line would change source without anyone noticing.

findings.action: Before 17:40Z, run in PowerShell: Stop-Process -Id 36816 -Force. Then check that (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'pre_exp89t' }).Count is 0, and log one CONTEXT line: 'pre_exp89t.sh (pid 36816) killed <ts> per the 13:34Z cancel; 0 calls at 17:40Z'. Do NOT kill the exp89t watcher 30864, manual_admit 3028 or t7_trigger 29648. If the main session would rather keep the job so the 18:37Z card has a fresh rank, it must log that instead, because the job contradicts the logged cancel either way.

findings.what: mk_card_1837.py takes CODE, --disp, --hdr and --lhi from the operator but never checks them against each other. So a typing slip at 18:37Z can build a card that breaks decision B or the admit edge, and the token checks still pass. Tested in memory, with no file written. 'T1 --disp 0.959' builds a promotion card ('V_pub = exp89t ... 0.959', П3 {exp89t, #37}). 'T2 --hdr 19:50:34Z --lhi 10.84' builds a promotion card past the 19:45:17Z edge (it should be T8). 'T3KEEP' after the edge builds. 'T5 --disp 0.960' builds a no-change card. An --lhi that disagrees with --hdr builds. The obsolete code 'T3' is still in PROMO and builds a promotion at 0.959. T1 or T2 without --llo crashes with a TypeError.

In-memory test at 14:20Z: all 5 bad inputs BUILT. The patched build then passed 35/35 variants and rejected all 6 bad inputs, including 'obsolete T3'. Edges: T0 09:00:17Z, 10.2 h = 19:12:17Z, 10.75 h = 19:45:17Z. The R38-A5 T8 edge is H + 210 s x F; runtime_ledger RETRY_SLACK_S = 210.

In --dry-all, drop UPWAIT/T3/T4 from V. Also change the --lb default from 'pre_exp89t' to 'e10_20260929T1141Z' and default --teams to 3994. Re-run --dry-all (expect 35/35 ok) and log the new sha8 in CONTEXT.

findings.what: The 18:37Z card's LB line is mislabelled and staler than what we already know. (a) With the fallback, the card reads 'Мы на ЛБ (14:45 МСК): #141 из 3 994 ... место 17 из 22'. The time comes from the lb.csv mtime, which is the 11:45Z mk_s0 build, while the snapshot itself is 11:41Z (14:41 МСК). (b) Chrome at 13:20Z already showed #148 of 3 999 (CONTEXT 13:58Z), and later Chrome reads may show more. So at 21:37 МСК the card would give the user a 7-hour-old rank. (c) If the watcher's post_exp89t download fails after uptest.save has already made the folder, '--lb post_exp89t' crashes with an IndexError in uptest.load. Under B, post_exp89t exists only on a 0.959 read.

The dry-run T3KEEP card l.8 reads 'Мы на ЛБ (14:45 МСК): #141 из 3 994'. mk_card l.60-62 (lbt = max mtime). uptest.save runs mkdir before the download, and load() globs *.zip/*.csv. CONTEXT l.4641: Chrome 13:20Z #148 of 3 999, 17th of 22.
findings.action: Cosmetic and optional. In mk_card, when the tag matches e10_YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ, take the label time from the tag (14:41 МСК), not from the mtime. Use --lb post_exp89t only if the folder holds a .zip or .csv, otherwise the fallback. Optionally add a '--rankline' override that fills the LB line from the newest Chrome read with its own time, e.g. '#148 из 3 999 (Chrome 16:20 МСК)'. The label already dates the number, so if nothing is changed the card is still honest.

findings.what: lastok.sh, which t7_trigger.sh and manual_admit.sh use, skips any poll block whose header contains '[empty stdout'. The poller writes that note even when a retry succeeded and the block holds a valid list, so valid blocks get skipped. Effect: T7 can fire at the next header (~19:30:30Z instead of ~19:20:28Z), and manual-admit can make one unneeded call if exp89t is already terminal in the skipped 19:40Z block. There is no false admit or false T8. The exp89t watcher 30864 uses last() over all blocks and is not affected. Per poll the chance is ~0.5% (3 such headers in ~570 polls).
findings.evidence: poll.log l.23505-23506 '=== 2026-09-28T15:15:31Z [empty stdout ...] [empty stdout ...]' is followed by 'ref,fileName,...' (the 3rd attempt succeeded); likewise l.377-378 (25 Sep 19:11:08Z). lb_poll.py writes the note plus the output of the successful attempt. lastok.sh: ok = ($0 !~ /\[empty stdout/).
findings.action: No action needed. If anything is touched, define lastok as the newest block that contains a '^ref,' line (awk: keep the current block, remember it as good when it matches /\nref,/, print the last good one). At T7, if the session sees an empty status line, it reads poll.log directly.
